title: Tech Note: Limiting Access When Using 4D Client Across the Internet

historical_commentary.text: The core concern — controlling and auditing remote access to a database server — remains a fundamental, still highly relevant security practice, but current 4D Server deployments have far more robust built-in access control, encryption (TLS), and network security options than were available in 2002, making the specific mitigation techniques in this note largely superseded by modern equivalents.
related_updates: Current 4D Server versions provide more robust built-in network security, TLS encryption, and access control options than were available in 2002
